messages.text: Sequence A is done. I stopped it for the 14 people who replied, so nobody gets a follow-up after answering.
Of the 14 replies, 9 booked a meeting, 3 asked for later and 2 said no. The later ones get a note in January.
Why only fintech ops for B?
The new customer profile says fintech ops teams close fastest: 41 of the 212 won deals, in 19 days on average. The list of 180 is built from that.
